fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) rose 13.69% on Wednesday to trade at $977.69, with Evercore ISI setting a $2,500 price target (156% upside from current price).
fields.summary_ko.1: In Q1 FY2027, net income surged 7,133% year-over-year to $810 million, and revenue increased 378% to $1.103 billion, reflecting strong NAND product demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: Supply discipline and structural business changes are expected to drive more sustainable profitability, with pricing increases extending from historically two quarters to six quarters.
